tldr: For every fixed public entropy parameter \(\varepsilon>0\), this note constructs a feasible full-continuum-kernel Sinkhorn test for equality of causal outcome distributions under a known power propensity. The test has uniform asymptotic upper level on the prescribed heterogeneous marginal null, a certified finite interval-arithmetic and finite-bit implementation, and explicit strict local power. Its local-effect scale undergoes a three-regime transition: \(n^{-1/2}\) for \(\gamma<1\), \(\sqrt{\log n/n}\) for \(\gamma=1\), and \(n^{-1/(\gamma+1)}\) for \(\gamma>1\), with Gaussian, logarithmic-boundary, and marked-Poisson reference experiments respectively. The calibration retains the global continuum Sinkhorn kernel and the same-record diagonal.
